- Stalk/ear rots are close-ups of stalk/ear tissue — not matching
- Crazy Top shows proliferated tassel — not matching
- Corn_Stunt_Spiroplasma references showed reddish discoloration, not field-level stunting
- **Maize_Chlorotic_Dwarf_Virus (Corn_Disease_51.jpg)** is the strongest match: identical field perspective, stunted bushy plants alongside normal tall ones, same reddish soil, same geographic context

The MCDV reference image 51 is nearly identical in composition and symptom presentation to the test image.
